blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A lawmaker is proposing the provision of more powers to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) so that it can fight rogue online lending applications (OLA) and abusive debt collectors, amid numerous complaints filed before authorities. In a statement on Wednesday, Quezon City Rep. Patrick Michael Vargas said he has filed House Bill (HB) No. 9738, or the proposed Fair Debt Collection and Digital Lending Consumer Protection Act, which seeks to empower the SEC and create a list of prohibited actions—like harassment of loanees, threats of violence, and public shaming.
